{{Top}}
{{Quote|What in - Kenobi, are you ''sick?"<br />"''No. A headache. It's nothing.''"<br />"''It's not nothing. You look like you're about to retch.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Odion_has_a_headahce.png|thumb|right|280px|A young [[Odion]] with a severe headache.]]
A '''headache''' described a pain in the head that was experienced by a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being, such as [[Human/Legends|humans]]<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> and [[Gand/Legends|Gands]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

If there was a trace of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] in a breathable [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], it could cause beings to develop headaches. After she and her [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] compatriots were rescued by [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] suffered from a headache while on the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']], as a small amount of ammonia had remained in the air of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]' [[Starship/Legends|ship]] after it was replaced by oxygen.<ref name="OPF" />

Strong [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] and loud noise would sometimes cause headaches as well,<ref name="Kenobi novel">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref> as could lack of [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]].<ref name="The Last Jedi novel">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref> Pressure to the skull could also lead to headaches,<ref name="Roll of the Dice">{{InsiderCite|135|Roll of the Dice}}</ref> as could a [[Concussion/Legends|concussion]].<ref name="Razor's">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] suffered from debilitating headaches during his childhood [[Standard year/Legends|years]], caused by his hypersensitive [[The Force/Legends|Force]] connection.<ref name="Knight Errant: Escape 3">[[Knight Errant: Escape 3|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 3]]</ref>

Commercial headache remedies,<ref name="Dawn"> ''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> in the form of painkillers<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space" /> could be swallowed dry or taken with liquid, and could cure a headache.<ref name="Dawn" /> One type of headache remedy was a special type of white tablet taken with a glass of [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="Alien Encounters article series">{{JournalCite|15|Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters: The Shard}}</ref> Capsules were another type of painkiller.<ref name="Razor's" />
